parts.text: As a dispatcher, I plan and run the flights by deciding which drone flies and along which way, and I sign off a flight before it leaves. My job involves carrying out deliveries that move a load from one site to another, and inspections that take a drone with the right sensors to a list of points in a set order and bring it back to where the inspection started. Several of us plan at the same time for the same busy sites and popular drones, and I can call off a flight. While I want help finding out which of my drones could get to where a job starts, our policy is that software never chooses a drone or a way for us.
